fields.Name: T126 - Admin ERD Diagram Viewer
fields.Description: Verifies the Admin app's Data & Schema > ERD sub-section renders the interactive entity-relationship diagram with entity boxes and relationship lines without crashing.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Admin app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). Open the 'Data & Schema' section, then in its left sub-navigation click the 'ERD' sub-section. The success state is the interactive entity-relationship diagram rendering with entity boxes and lines connecting related entities. The diagram can be heavy and pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained env - wait for the diagram to render, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Admin app is active with the Data & Schema section open and the ERD sub-section selected in the left sub-navigation
An interactive entity-relationship diagram is rendered showing multiple entity boxes
Relationship lines connecting entities are visible in the diagram
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
